newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes strike again in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes strike again in Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli planes attacked Hizbollah targets in south Lebanon again on Friday evening -- their third raid on the area since guerrillas killed three Israeli soldiers, Lebanese security sources said.
They said two warplanes fired four rockets into the hills of Daidaba in the area of Jabal ad-Dahr south of the Syrian-controlled Bekaa Valley. There was no immediate word on casualties.
The attack raised this year's tally of Israeli air attacks in Lebanon to 33.
Hizbollah guerrillas killed three Israeli soldiers and wounded seven overnight in fierce clashes just outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
The deaths brought to nine the number of Israeli soldiers killed and to 35 the number of wounded in guerrilla attacks in south Lebanon in 1997.
Shortly after the clashes, Israeli helicopters stuck into the area. They hit again on Friday morning.
Hizbollah is fighting to oust the Israeli troops from the 15 km- (nine mile) wide strip they occupy in south Lebanon.
